prechecks.assumptions: Applicable: infinite axial field; stop at/before fixed reference; every refractor after reference; M2 edits keep fixed aperture caps, fixed stop/reference and no pre-stop optical element. At least one required rim ray is clipped before first refraction. This is not a general infeasibility claim for internal stops, finite conjugates or adjustable apertures.

trials.detail: Insertion exceeds the allowed element count.
